hints.title: Segment Partitioning
hints.text: Sick children partition healthy children into left end segment, interior segments, and right end segment.

hints.title: Interior Segment Options
hints.text: An interior segment of length L can be infected from both boundaries, yielding 2^(L - 1) internal orderings. End segments have only 1 internal ordering.

hints.title: Multinomial Permutations
hints.text: Multiply factorial(total_uninfected) / product(factorial(L_i)) by product(2^(L_int - 1)) modulo 10^9 + 7 using modular inverse factorials.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing factorials and modular inverse with multinomial coefficient.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all infection tree paths is intractable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derive multinomial coefficient formula combined with 2^(L-1) interior powers.
